title: A Novel Metric for Measuring the Robustness of Large Language Models in Non-adversarial Scenarios
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel metric for evaluating LLM robustness. While it utilizes the SIGA dataset, which concerns social identity group abuse (including religion), the paper benchmarks classification consistency and robustness across perturbations rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, faith traditions, or ethical systems themselves.
